correctness.rationale: Exactly 30,991 faces reconstructed from the 36-point Hamming metric. A deterministic matching has 15,447 disjoint covers, one critical vertex, 96 critical tetrahedra, and a topological-order witness validating all 178,668 directed Hasse incidences; Forman therefore supplies an integral wedge of 96 three-spheres. Independent second checker verifies 14,227 free-face collapses, trivial fundamental group by 352 explicit triangle eliminations, 833 unimodular boundary pivots and rank 96 top homology. Below/above scale two the coordinate-line collapse and full simplex are elementary. All quantifiers cover a fixed finite product and all real r≥0.

value.rationale: The unequal-size (3,3,4) triple is the first natural asymmetric all-factor-at-least-three instance adjacent to the published 3x3x3 calculation and within the 2023 categorical-product conjecture. It receives a full integral homotopy type and complete metric-persistence barcode, rather than only numerical homology, with two fully reproducible combinatorial certificates for an originally eleven-dimensional complex. This finite natural invariant is relevant to the broader unsolved three-factor problem; no general theorem is claimed.
